newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank/Greece awaits 97 budget before FX decisions.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Greece awaits 97 budget before FX decisions.

text.p: The Bank of Greece, the country's central bank, is awaiting the 1997 budget before charting its monetary and foreign exchange policy for next year, a high-level central bank official told Reuters.
"We are awaiting the 1997 budget before deciding on the exact instruments and measures to achieve our policy goals next year," the official said.
He stressed, however, that monetary and foreign exchange policy would remain anti-inflationary.

"What is certain is that the foreign exchange policy will continue to be anti-inflationary in 1997," said the official who added that short-term fluctuations of drachma parities would relate to market conditions as in 1996. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
